newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end higher after benign U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end higher after benign U.S. data.

text.p: French shares ended higher on Friday after key U.S. economic data showed inflation was restrained.
But turnover remained limited as many investors had stayed on the sidelines awaiting the U.S. figures.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 11.49 points or 0.54 percent at 2,147.12 while the CAC-40 futures contract was up at 2,152 from 2,138 on Thursday's close.
Over the week, the CAC-40 index lost 17.06 points or 0.79 percent.
Elf-Aquitaine closed up 2.8 percent to 405 francs after SGB sold seven million shares. French foreign minister on visit in Bakou, where Elf has 10 percent of Shah Deniz field.
Bouygues closed up 4.21 percent to 508 francs after announcing telecommunications alliance with STET of Italy.

Rhone Poulenc was down 0.43 percent to 139.50 francs after falling nearly three percent on Thursday following profit warning.Rhone-Poulenc's unit Rhone-Poulenc Rorer said on Thursday its profits would be 10 to 12 percent below forecasts due to a product recall.
Rhone-Poulenc said its 1996 net could drop by six to seven percent as a result.
